column1: # The desk pet's flash map (16 MB). It is the Arduino Nano ESP32's own table
# (app3M_fat9M_fact512k_16MB) with the FAT partition used for LittleFS instead.
# Two app slots so signed over-the-air updates can come in phase 4; the nvs and
# otadata places stay where the Arduino bootloader of the Nano ESP32 expects them.
# The factory slot is the Nano's own recovery firmware. It must stay: a double
# press of RST starts the board's DFU bootloader by finding that partition
# without it the chip just restarts into the sketch. LittleFS ends before it
# format or the wear levelling never writes over the recovery image.
# LittleFS uses the "spiffs" subtype and is mounted by the label "littlefs"
